name: Youko
source: A water fairy type monster girl. Youko spends most of her time in or near fountains. She does not fight for or against [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url] and seems to be the only neutral monster girl on Squid Paradise. She asks [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] for favors along his journey and asks to have sex with him in exchange but he refuses so she gives him powerup items instead.
